Definition: Aggregate struct describing a mechanics verification fixture (fixture_id, family, description, assumptions, provenance, unit_basis, expected_values).
Enum of fixture families (Cantilever, Frame, StraightPipe, SupportBoundary, PrimitiveLoad, IntegratedLinearStatic, LoadToResultantIntegration, ThermalGrowth, ImposedDisplacement, StiffnessTransform).
Struct recording fixture provenance and public-original/reviewed status.
Struct of explicit fixture-local unit identifiers; no conversion constants encoded.
Named expected result with value, unit, dimension, and optional tolerance policy.
Fixtures characterized as verification aids only, with no acceptance criteria or professional reliance claims.
Marker that the tolerance policy, conversion constants, and canonical unit catalog remain unresolved.
Fixture-local unit system references for mechanics and nonlinear crates.
Resultant (shear_y, bending_z) at a station fraction along a member.
Thermal and pressure axial effects prepared and recovered for straight pipe elements.
Per-expected-value tolerance policy, left unresolved (None) across fixtures.
Canonical analytical payload (TP-PHYS-014) driving solver consumption and result-envelope evidence.
